title: This airport waits for the tide to go out
hook: Its runway is a beach, so flights work around the tides
summary: Barra Airport in Scotland uses a beach as its runway. Scheduled flights follow the tides. Once the airport closes and the windsock is down, people can walk on the beach.

text: At one airport, flying means checking the tides. Barra Airport in Scotland has a beach for a runway.
Scheduled passenger planes land on sand covered and uncovered by the sea. Flight times work around the tides.

panels.text: The sea is still using the runway!

text: This isn't merely an airport near the beach. Planes use the same space that the water occupies.
Once the airport closes and the windsock is down, people can walk there as on any beach.
Someone arrives by plane, and later someone else takes a seaside stroll in the same place.

panels.text: The sea gets a say in the flight schedule.
